summary: Cartesian Growth Corp IV, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K announcing that holders of its IPO units may elect to separately trade the underlying Class A ordinary shares and warrants starting August 17, 2026. The separated securities will trade on Nasdaq under CGCF and CGCFW, while unseparated units continue under CGCFU. No fractional warrants will be issued. This is a routine administrative event enabling unit separation, not a special-situation transaction. There are no deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions. The filing merely facilitates the standard post-IPO separation of units, with no impact on valuation or corporate control.
